pretreatments.description: Combined alkaline and mechanical pretreatment using different alkali agents (NaOH, KOH, Ca(OH)_2) at pH levels between 8 and 11, followed by mechanical shearing with an IKA T25 Ultra Turrax digital disperser operating at RPMs of 4000 to 24000 over treatment periods of 15 to 180 minutes, with sludge samples stored at 4 °C.
